preconditions.description: The hidden integers a and b are non-negative and strictly less than 2^30.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c < 2**30 and 0 <= d < 2**30 for c, d in query_pairs)
preconditions.description: Every query pair (c, d) sent by the program must consist of non-negative integers less than 2^30.
The total number of queries made must not exceed 62.

postconditions.description: The program terminates by printing a line starting with '!' followed by two integers.
The two integers printed in the final output exactly match the hidden integers a and b.

postconditions.expression: all(response == 1 if (hidden_a ^ c) > (hidden_b ^ d) else (0 if (hidden_a ^ c) == (hidden_b ^ d) else -1) for (c, d), response in zip(query_pairs, responses))
postconditions.description: For every query (c, d) made, the response received from stdin correctly reflects the comparison of (a XOR c) and (b XOR d).
